title: Aerial Reconnaissance
subtitle: Drone-Based Target and Route Investigation
description: Conduct an aerial reconnaissance mission over the previously selected observation target. Use the existing drone to inspect the target approach route, capture aerial evidence, and prepare observations for the ground investigation on Sol 6.

persistentMissionData.selectionRule: Use only the target selected and submitted by the player during Sol 3. Do not allow a new target selection during Sol 5.

tasks.title: Complete Drone Flight Operations Briefing
tasks.objective: Review and confirm the target-dependent manual-flight briefing.

tasks.title: Activate Drone Reconnaissance Simulation
tasks.objective: Activate the existing Drone_Object simulation after prerequisites validate.

tasks.title: Inspect the Officially Selected Target
tasks.objective: Manually fly to and inspect the official target, then load only its existing evidence assets.

tasks.title: Return and Safely Land the Drone
tasks.objective: Manually return to the launch pad, validate landing with E, then press G to return to Mission Control Navigation.

tasks.title: Review Target-Specific Evidence
tasks.objective: Review the mission-provided imagery linked to the official target.

tasks.title: Submit Sol 5 Aerial Reconnaissance Report
tasks.objective: Submit a target-linked report with observations, interpretation, uncertainty, and Sol 6 follow-up.

objectives.title: Complete Drone Mission Briefing
objectives.description: Visit the Mission Control main console and review the Sol 5 aerial reconnaissance objectives, selected target, operational boundaries, and flight restrictions.
objectives.completionCondition: The player reviews and confirms the Sol 5 mission briefing.

objectives.title: Inspect Drone Readiness
objectives.description: Optionally visit the Drone Section and physically inspect the existing drone to review its available operational status information.
objectives.completionCondition: The player interacts with the existing drone inspection interaction and reviews the available status information.

objectives.title: Activate Aerial Reconnaissance
objectives.description: Return to Mission Control and activate the drone simulation through the existing OS Navigation interface.
objectives.completionCondition: The existing drone simulation is successfully initialized and the player enters drone first-person control mode.

objectives.title: Survey the Selected Target
objectives.description: Manually fly the existing drone from Drone_TakeoffPoint to the Sol 3 selected target, following visual guidance without autopilot.
objectives.completionCondition: The player manually reaches the official target's validated inspection area.

objectives.title: Inspect the Selected Target and Load Its Evidence
objectives.description: Press E in the selected target's validated inspection area to load its existing mission-provided image evidence.
objectives.completionCondition: The correct selected-target scene object is inspected and its existing target-specific images are associated with mission progress.

objectives.title: Return and Land the Drone
objectives.description: After target inspection, manually return to the original take-off point and confirm a validated landing with E.
objectives.completionCondition: The inspected drone reaches the verified take-off point, satisfies landing conditions, and enters the landed state after E confirmation.

objectives.title: Review Aerial Images
objectives.description: Return to the normal player view and review the selected target's pre-prepared evidence through the existing Mission Control OS.
objectives.completionCondition: The player reviews the available mission-provided images associated with the official target; no live capture metadata is claimed.

objectives.title: Submit Aerial Reconnaissance Report
objectives.description: Prepare and submit the Sol 5 report using the selected target's prepared imagery and verified mission records.
objectives.completionCondition: The report passes the mission validation rules and is successfully submitted.

destinations.label: Mission Control Main Console
destinations.purpose: Review the mission briefing and activate the drone simulation.

destinations.label: Airlock Access
destinations.purpose: Access the existing outdoor operational area.

destinations.label: Mission Control Report Station
destinations.purpose: Review aerial evidence and submit the mission report.

restrictions: Do not expose internal physical screen names in player-facing navigation.
Do not expose trigger IDs or implementation identifiers in player-facing navigation.
Do not mark an objective complete merely because the player reaches a destination.

controls.E_context: Ascend during flight; interact at the selected-target inspection area or validated landing area without also ascending.
